patterns.note: Sections are full-width with content centered, using a dark background and high-contrast white text for readability and impact.
Dominant use of extremely bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif typography for all major headings, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is accented by vibrant, shifting red and blue gradients that serve as dynamic background elements or overlays.

The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, while a dynamic background gradient subtly shifts and parallaxes behind the content as the user scrolls down the page.
Major content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, appearing to animate into view from the bottom with a subtle entrance effect.
Each primary content section is introduced by a very large, uppercase, condensed sans-serif heading, clearly segmenting the page's information.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport after the initial hero section scrolls past, ensuring navigation is always accessible.
Content sections are designed to reveal themselves with scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes to create a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport.
A large, animated gradient background is used, which either parallaxes or shifts its position and color composition as the user scrolls, adding a dynamic and immersive feel to the dark aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extremely bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) dominate the page, contrasted with a smaller, utilitarian monospace for body text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements featuring crisp, angular corners, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable padding within content blocks, creating a clear visual rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, shifting gradient background that interacts with the dark, high-contrast typography creates a futuristic and energetic feel, setting it apart from typical event or competition pages. The bold, condensed typography also contributes significantly to this unique aesthetic.
